summary: The Chief- Training and Strategic Development role is becoming more strategic, digital, and transformation-oriented. Static classroom materials and manual feedback collection will decline, while continuous workforce enablement, digital learning design, evidence-based evaluation, and targeted action planning will expand. The role will increasingly support adoption of AI, automated workflows, enterprise platforms, secure operations, and mixed-source production models. Automation exposure is medium: some content production and feedback collection tasks can be automated, but the role grows in importance as a change-enablement, readiness, and capability-development function.
